title: Bug 652154: [Subcontracting] Add feature uptake telemetry
summary: Telemetry instrumentation added to track Subcontracting feature adoption from discovery through setup to operational use, centralizing event tracking while preserving existing signals.
key_points: New telemetry codeunit centralizes Subcontracting feature name and event IDs for consistent tracking
Captures discovery when opening the Subcontracting Worksheet
Tracks setup completion via assisted setup, work center assignment, or subcontractor price creation
Records operational use when creating subcontracting purchase-order lines
Backfills missing earlier states to maintain proper Discovered -> Set up -> Used transition for existing companies
quote: Add the complete feature uptake funnel for the Subcontracting app so adoption can be measured from discovery through configuration and real operational use.
